[[File:GPL VHS Cover.jpg|thumb|250px|Rental-only VHS Cover]]
(Japanese: '''げきとう! ポケモンリーグ!!''' ''Fierce Battles! Pokémon League!!'') is the third and final episode in a series of three [[clip show]]s released as OVAs in 2000 called '''Pocket Monsters TV Special: {{tt|Masara Town|Pallet Town}} Arc Recap''', available on rental-only VHS. They chronicled the events of {{aniseries|OS}} throughout {{Ash}}'s [[Indigo League]] journey. This episode is entirely made up of clips from the [[Indigo Plateau Conference]], showing select events from ''[[EP075|Round One - Begin!]]'' to ''[[EP080|Friends to the End]]''. Like the second episode, but unlike the first, the episode does not have any footage previously exclusive to TV clipshows or [[Dare Da?]] eyecatches. Segments are occasionally broken up by Team Rocket's exploits during the conference.
